description: One advertising market record. One complete market record from the Ni Biashara advertising shelf: the segment's published revenue points (actuals and forecasts), CAGR, share points and the publisher's own framing note. Query by record id or segment name. $0.1 USDC on Base. Returns the x402 URL to GET (402 → PAYMENT-SIGNATURE → delivery). Free to call this tool; payment happens on the URL.

id.description: market record id, e.g. iab-us-search (this or segment required)

segment.description: segment name, exact or close match (this or id required)
